summary:

[Done] Deleted reports/alpha.md and reports/gamma.md (both contained "DRAFT"). Copied reports/beta.md content to reports/beta-final.md and deleted the original reports/beta.md.
[State] The reports folder now contains only reports/beta-final.md.
[Key values] reports/beta-final.md
reports/alpha.md
reports/gamma.md
reports/beta.md
[Decisions] Treated "DRAFT" as a literal substring test on file content to identify obsolete files.
[User] The user is working with a reports folder and expects strict, content-preserving file operations.
